why: Setup step before the scikit-learn plan's first lesson (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/scikit-learn.json), shaped like the MNIST lesson's venv step. The learner first typed the import name, `pip install sklearn`, and pip failed building the deprecated placeholder package ('error: metadata-generation-failed', 'The 'sklearn' PyPI package is deprecated, use 'scikit-learn''). They then ran `pip install scikit-learn` in the same venv: 'Successfully installed ... scikit-learn-1.5.2 ...', and the import check printed 1.5.2. The install the step asks for happened; the errors on screen are the wrong package name's.

step.title: Install scikit-learn in a virtual environment
step.instructions: Make a venv and install the library: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install scikit-learn. Check it with python -c "import sklearn; print(sklearn.__version__)".
